relationships.subject: VX548
relationships.evidence_quote: We first validated the isolation of Nav1.8 currents using the specific inhibitor VX548 (100 μM), which significantly reduced the sodium current amplitude (Fig 4A–C).

relationships.subject: BAY 11–7082

relationships.subject: BAY 11–7082
relationships.evidence_quote: To evaluate the effects of the NF-κB inhibitor BAY 11–7082 on pain-related behaviors and locomotor activity, we performed a series of behavioral assessments.

key_findings: In a rat plantar incision model, TNF-α drives NF-κB-dependent Nav1.8 upregulation in DRG neurons and exacerbates postoperative thermal and spontaneous pain.
Intrathecal NF-κB inhibitor BAY 11–7082 reversed behavioral, cytokine and Nav1.8 current changes, with limited effect on mechanical allodynia.
